verdict.rationale: Clara's agent instructions document a first-party Clara MCP that lets a user's AI assistant inspect and act on Clara data in natural language, including listing cards, reviewing transactions, switching companies and locking cards, with confirmation guardrails before money-moving Pix payments. Natural-language operation is mediated through an external AI assistant rather than a native in-product command interface. Missing for 10: detailed MCP setup and tool-coverage documentation, a native in-app natural-language command surface (Clara Intelligence is described only as insights and a CFO agent, not command execution), independent or hands-on corroboration.
